name: M HKA
known: Flor Bex was the first director, until 1992, and Bart de Baere led it from 2002 (Wikipedia).
V-A-C Foundation (Novatek founder) still listed.

name: Argos
known: Founding directors were Koen Van Daele (1989 to 1993) and Frie Depraetere (1989 to 2013).

name: Beursschouwburg
known: Dutch Wikipedia states that the centre is managed by the Flemish Community Commission (VGC) and names Melat Gebeyaw Nigussie as general director and artistic leader.

name: Fondation CAB
known: Programme: two exhibitions a year, one major show of internationally known minimal art and one of young artists inspired by minimalism, plus special projects from galleries, museums and curators (the foundation's website).
Director: Eléonore de Sadeleer (the foundation's website).

Bonnet is a Belgian businessman and collector; after his mother died in 1996 he returned to Belgium, became a director of Cobepa until its 2000 takeover, then founded H Group, which develops luxury residences (Wikipedia).
The founder is the sole funder.

name: La Loge
known: Founded by the architect Philippe Rotthier, now Honorary President.
Activities began in 2012 under founding director Anne-Claire Schmitz (2012 to 2019).
Wim Waelput is the current director and curator.
Named members include Almine Rech Gallery and individual members, among them Pierre Iserbyt, whom the about page lists as chair of the board.

name: Van Buuren Museum & Gardens
known: The founder's money came from banking: David van Buuren was a director of the private bank Cassel (French Wikipedia).
Lists its eight directors on its site, matching the Belgian company register (KBO 0407.561.930).

name: Villa Empain (Boghossian Foundation)
known: Cathy Van Keer-Boghossian chairs the board and Louma Salamé directs the villa (villaempain.com, stated by the space).

name: iMAL
known: Lucía García is the current director (iMAL).

name: Museum Dhondt-Dhaenens
known: Founded by the collectors Jules Dhondt and Irma Dhaenens, who settled in Deurle in 1938 and lived in Villa Zodenhof.

Board: nine members chaired by Christine Claus, with Philippe Leeman as vice-president; the director since 2023 is Goedele Bartholomeeusen, after Antony Hudek (2020 to 2023) and Joost Declercq (2004 to 2019) (museum website, team page).

name: CIAP
known: The team is led by director Brenda Guesnet, with Karel Op 't Eynde as curator (Jester).

name: KIOSK
known: Team named by KIOSK: Simon Delobel (director), Sara Plantefève-Castryck (mediation, press and communication), Thomas Peeters and Sam Van Ingelgem (production managers).
Kunstensite vzw is its governing board: Claudine Hellweg (chair), Lies Leliaert, Filip Rathé, Shila Anaraki, Anne-Françoise Lesuisse, Claire Stragier and Sevie Tsampalla.
The School of Arts is also the co-founder of the initiative (artlead.net).
KIOSK is run through Kunstensite vzw and tied to the School of Arts Ghent, KASK & Conservatorium, part of HOGENT.

name: Kunsthal Gent
known: It shares its rooms with the programmes of Art Cinema OFFoff, the Curatorial Studies programme of KASK & Conservatorium, and das Kunst.

name: S.M.A.K.
known: The museum was founded in 1975, housed first in the Museum of Fine Arts, with Jan Hoet as director from 1975 (stated by the museum).
Philippe Van Cauteren succeeded Hoet as director in 2005 (stated by the museum).
